notes:
Seabyss 0.1.7-beta.58

- Refreshed top navigation, clearer menus and sharper interface icons.
- Refined minimap with compact tooltips and an attached camera zoom control.
- Improved Shipyard portraits, quest cards and Pirate Exam reward presentation.
- Fixed Quest initialization that could interrupt profile loading.
- Shellborn now has a 50% chance to drop 1–25 Diamonds; Vexar has a 25% chance to drop 1–10. Encyclopedia entries reflect these rewards.
- Preserves the Beta 57 profile archive and durable reward protections.

Launcher version remains 0.1.9.
